title: Workout optimiser
headline: For Khamis Mushait National Estates (B-, Stage 3, EAD SAR 58.7m), the best route is: Partial exit (40% repaid now). Recovery NPV SAR 51.9m (88.4% of EAD), SAR 11.2m more than holding, net of capital cost.
summary: For Khamis Mushait National Estates (B-, Stage 3, EAD SAR 58.7m), the best route is: Partial exit (40% repaid now). Recovery NPV SAR 51.9m (88.4% of EAD), SAR 11.2m more than holding, net of capital cost.
It has been restructured 2 times in 24 months in financial difficulty, so a reschedule would be the third and force Stage 3 (CBUAE CRM 9.29).
Reschedule: Stage 3, ECL SAR 30.9m (unchanged), recovery NPV SAR 43.1m.
Sale frees SAR 4.0m of capital and releases the ECL for SAR 32.3m cash today; legal action recovers SAR 31.9m in present value.

data_limits: Cure probabilities, sale discounts, legal timelines and costs are expert assumptions (assumptions.json): the book holds only 12 cured restructurings and no loan-sale or court-recovery history.
Extra collateral is assumed to be real estate at the Deal Desk haircut and recognised as CRM the way col_crwa recognises it.
Recovery NPV values the obligor's exposure on the bank's books; the relationship's other income is not included.
The comparison is one year; a reschedule's longer path (probation, later re-default) is folded into its cure probability.
method: Each option: recovery NPV at the LGD discount rate, ECL by the stage CBUAE assigns, capital at the target ratio.
Ranking: recovery NPV less one year of the option's capital at the sector hurdle.

clauses.9.29: Any Credit Facility restructured 3 times or more in a context of financial difficulty must be migrated to Stage 3.
clauses.9.28: Distressed restructured facilities meeting UTP or over 90 days past due at the conclusion are Stage 3.
clauses.9.30: Other distressed restructured facilities are allocated to Stage 2 or Stage 3.
clauses.6.8(c): Selling part of a facility at an economic loss over 30% is an unlikeliness-to-pay indicator.
clauses.6.8(d): Filing for the obligor's bankruptcy or a similar order is an unlikeliness-to-pay indicator.
